2/S0.subgoal: Outline the scope and goals of the lecture on application domains and system categories.

2/S1.subgoal: Describe the major application domains of virtual reality technologies, including gaming, healthcare, education, and defense.

2/S2.subgoal: Introduce the systems categorization framework by explaining that VR applications vary in their degrees of immersion.

2/S3.subgoal: Explain the characteristics and operational principles of non-immersive VR systems.

2/S4.subgoal: Describe semi-immersive systems, noting their partial sensory blocking and common commercial usage.

2/S5.subgoal: Illustrate fully immersive systems by detailing the required hardware and the complete replacement of reality with virtual realism.

2/S6.subgoal: Summarize the properties of the three VR system categories and conclude the discussion on VR applications.
